literal: Having investigated, without showing favoritism, desiring impartiality, towards anyone, having deliberated, doing [justice] indeed is the way of a righteous reign.
translation: To investigate a matter thoroughly, to show no favoritism, to lean only towards absolute impartiality, and to deliver judgment after careful deliberation is the true path of justice.
modern: ஒரு குற்றத்தை நன்கு ஆராய்ந்து, யாரிடமும் பட்சபாதம் காட்டாமல், நடுநிலைமை தவறாமல், சட்டங்களை நன்கு ஆலோசித்துத் தண்டனை வழங்குவதே முறையான ஆட்சியாகும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the core duties of a ruler or judge in maintaining a righteous reign. First, they must fully investigate the facts of a case without rushing to judgment. Second, they must remain completely unbiased, refusing to let personal relationships or status influence their view. Third, they must lean only towards absolute impartiality, and finally, they must consult the laws and deliberate carefully before delivering a verdict. Following these steps is what defines true justice.
